test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Match the following:

 
 

 
 
**Soda**

 
 
 
**Chemical formula**

 
 
 

 
 
(i)

 
 
 
Caustic Soda

 
 
 
(a)

 
 
 
NaHCO₃

 
 
 

 
 
(ii)

 
 
 
Baking Soda

 
 
 
(b)

 
 
 
Na₂CO₃

 
 
 

 
 
(iii)

 
 
 
Washing Soda

 
 
 
(c)

 
 
 
NaOH

options.text: i - c, ii - b, iii - a
i - a, ii - c, iii - b
i - c, ii - a, iii - b
i - a, ii - b, iii - c

solution:
The correct answer is __**i - c, ii - a, iii - b.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** correct matching of soda** and their chemical formula are i - a (Caustic Soda - NaOH), ii - c (Baking Soda - Na₂CO₃), and iii - b (Washing Soda - NaHCO₃).
 
• **Caustic soda** or sodium hydroxide (NaOH) is a **strong base** and **highly corrosive. **
 
• **Baking soda** or sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) is a **weak base** and commonly used as a** leavening agent** in baking. 
 
• **Washing soda** or sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) is a **strong base.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Caustic soda **is used in the production of **pulp and paper, textiles, soap,** and other chemicals.
 
• **Baking soda **can be used as a** cleaning agent** and to** neutralize acid**.
 
• **Washing soda** is used as **water softener and cleaning agent.** 
 
 
• It can also be used in the production of **glass, soaps, and detergents.**
